title.en: Meaning, importance and principles of directing

heading.en: Plans are ready, people are hired. Who switches on the action?
heading.kn: ಯೋಜನೆ ಸಿದ್ಧ, ನೌಕರರ ನೇಮಕ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಕೆಲಸ ಆರಂಭಿಸುವವರು ಯಾರು?

hook.en: A cricket team has a plan and eleven good players, yet it needs a captain on the field telling, guiding and encouraging. In an organisation, that is directing.
hook.kn: ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ತಂಡಕ್ಕೆ ಯೋಜನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹನ್ನೊಂದು ಉತ್ತಮ ಆಟಗಾರರು ಇದ್ದರೂ ಮೈದಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ನೀಡುವ ನಾಯಕ ಬೇಕು. ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅದೇ ನಿರ್ದೇಶನ.

objectives.en: Define directing and list its features

narration.en: A cricket team has a plan and eleven good players, yet it needs a captain on the field telling, guiding and encouraging. In an organisation, that is directing.
narration.kn: ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ತಂಡಕ್ಕೆ ಯೋಜನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹನ್ನೊಂದು ಉತ್ತಮ ಆಟಗಾರರು ಇದ್ದರೂ ಮೈದಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ನೀಡುವ ನಾಯಕ ಬೇಕು. ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅದೇ ನಿರ್ದೇಶನ.

body.en: Directing means instructing, guiding, communicating and motivating people in the organisation to achieve its objectives. It initiates action, takes place at every level of management, is a continuous process, and flows from top to bottom.
body.kn: ನಿರ್ದೇಶನ ಎಂದರೆ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಉದ್ದೇಶ ಸಾಧನೆಗೆ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಸೂಚನೆ, ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ, ಸಂವಹನ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ ನೀಡುವುದು. ಇದು ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಆರಂಭಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಎಲ್ಲ ಹಂತಗಳಲ್ಲೂ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರಂತರ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ.

title.en: On the board: Elements of directing

narration.en: Directing means telling, guiding and motivating people so that plans turn into action.

say.en: Directing means telling, guiding and motivating people so that plans turn into action.
It has four elements: supervision, motivation, leadership and communication.
It initiates action, happens at every level, is continuous, and flows from top to bottom.
Key principles: harmony of objectives, unity of command, and follow through.
The supervisor is the link pin between management and workers.

narration.en: Match each principle of directing to what the manager does.

prompt.en: Match each principle of directing to what the manager does.
prompt.kn: ನಿರ್ದೇಶನದ ಪ್ರತಿ ತತ್ವವನ್ನು ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕನ ಕ್ರಮಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ.

explanation.en: The principles of directing help managers get the best from people: one boss, shared goals, clear messages, the right technique and constant follow-up.

right.en: Uses rewards that bring out each worker's best
Links bonus to company profit so personal and company goals agree
A salesperson takes orders only from the sales manager
Uses praise for one team and incentives for another
Makes sure every instruction is clearly understood
Listens to the canteen grapevine to sense the mood
Influences workers without hurting their feelings
Checks how the instructions are being carried out

body.en: Directing initiates action, integrates employees' efforts, guides employees to fulfil their potential, helps introduce changes smoothly and brings stability and balance. Its principles include maximum individual contribution, harmony of objectives, unity of command, appropriate direction technique, managerial communication, use of informal organisation, leadership and follow through.
body.kn: ನಿರ್ದೇಶನ ಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಆರಂಭಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ನೌಕರರ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಗಳನ್ನು ಸಮನ್ವಯಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಲಭಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದೇಶದ ಏಕತೆ, ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳ ಸಾಮರಸ್ಯ, ಅನುಸರಣೆ ಮುಂತಾದವು ಇದರ ತತ್ವಗಳು.

points.en: Harmony of objectives: individual goals match organisational goals
Unity of command: orders from one superior only
Follow through: check that instructions are being carried out

narration.en: Directing initiates action, integrates employees' efforts, guides employees to fulfil their potential, helps introduce changes smoothly and brings stability and balance. Its principles include maximum individual contribution, harmony of objectives, unity of command, appropriate direction technique, managerial communication, use of informal organisation, leadership and follow through.

body.en: Supervision is overseeing subordinates at work, usually by the first-line manager. A supervisor keeps friendly relations with workers, is the link between workers and management, keeps the group united, ensures targets are met, gives on-the-job training, leads by example, and analyses performance and gives feedback.
body.kn: ಮೇಲ್ವಿಚಾರಣೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಅಧೀನ ನೌಕರರ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು. ಮೇಲ್ವಿಚಾರಕ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರು ಮತ್ತು ಆಡಳಿತದ ನಡುವಿನ ಕೊಂಡಿ, ತರಬೇತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತಿಸ್ಪಂದನೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.

problem.en: A factory shifts from manual billing to a new software system. Workers fear losing jobs. The manager explains the change, trains them and reassures them. Which importance of directing is shown?

steps.en: Workers resist change because they fear its effects.
Directing through explanation, motivation and leadership reduces this resistance.
So directing here helps introduce the change smoothly.

answer.en: Directing facilitates implementation of changes in the organisation.
